question: What social status did Mātaṅgī assume at that time according to the narrative?
premises: Mātaṅgī became situated in the last class
She became outcaste-born at that time
inference: Mātaṅgī assumed the status of one born in the lowest social class.
plain_english: Then Mātaṅgī, situated in the last class, became outcaste-born.
